CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Real .tmLanguage.json grammar loader (stdlib/editor/textmate_loader.prn) + first language mod, JSON (stdlib/editor/lang_json.prn), wired into the editor for real .json syntax highlighting. Fixed 3 real top-level name collisions (json/regex/array/expr). Structural CI fix: editor-demo's source list now lives in one shared file (examples/editor-demo-sources.txt), not two drifting copies. commits 45a0b51/d612408. (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
